title: Tata Imagination Challenge 2027
summary: Tata Group's national ideas challenge: pitch an original idea in line with the Tata ethos. The top 10 win cash and a Tata Trails immersion.
eligibility: Full-time UG or PG students from any stream at AICTE/UGC-approved Indian institutions. Individual entry.

prize.description: 2026 edition: ₹2 lakh cash to each of the top 10 (₹20 lakh), plus Tata Trails and career opportunities.

notes: 2026 registration closed on 13 September 2026; the link points to the 2026 listing. Expect the 2027 edition around July–September 2027.
